banner: **Custody and discovery evidence, not a result.** For each artifact in census gap list D (computational content with no committed implementation), this records whether an implementation was located: as code inside the comment itself (extracted byte-exact here), as a committed file the comment identifies by SHA-256, or as a Drive or Dropbox file found by metadata search. Nothing here was executed, and nothing here makes a correctness claim or a disposition. Credit 0 · sci NONE · OBL OPEN.
limits: The block classification and the committed-elsewhere judgments are made by Anthropic Claude subagents of this session. Independence credit 0.
Python extracts were compiled, never run. Compiling proves only that the text parses. Running, adopting or replaying any extract is a packet owner decision.
A PARTIAL extract needs the project modules or sibling files named in its dependencies field.
Drive and Dropbox candidates are metadata matches only (title, size, modified time). No bytes were fetched or compared, and titles can mislead.
NOT_LOCATED is not proof of absence: the code may exist under another name, in an unsearched store, or only in a local workspace.
Comment bodies are the versions the census recorded on 31 October. A comment edited later may differ; verify_extracts.py --live reports drift.

Census correction, census left unchanged: four extracted Lean blocks (three for C212, one for I2-OrdinaryH0Split) match files committed at Math- 06bac48e under frontiers/compact_source_cutoff_baseline_20261009/ and reachable from eight codex/compact-cutoff-* and codex/source-smooth-realization-* branches, none on Math- main. Three are byte-identical; the I2 block has one extra final newline. MANIFEST.json records commit, path, blob and relation under committed_elsewhere. These are additional carriers, not the reviewed implementations of the artifacts' own claims.
DRIVE_OR_DROPBOX_CANDIDATE requires a match whose title indicates code, a checker or a certificate. Matches on data, archives or reviews are listed on the row but leave it NOT_LOCATED.
